en.about_body: The official update manager for Edukasaun OS. EUS manages APT system packages and Flatpak applications with clear update categories and risk information.
en.ak_added: The key was added and the package lists were refreshed.
en.ak_intro: Add the signing key of a repository you trust. Without a repository the key is trusted for all repositories (for repositories added in a terminal); with a repository, EUS adds it safely with Signed-By and never creates a duplicate entry.
en.ak_invalid_name: Enter a name using lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
en.ak_invalid_repo: Enter the repository URI, the suite and the components.
en.ak_missing_source: Choose a key file, an https URL, or a key ID.
en.ak_preview_key:
The key will be trusted for every repository:
/etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/{name}.gpg
en.ak_repo: Also add the repository that uses this key
en.ak_title: Add Key — Install a GPG Key or Repository
en.ar_added: The repository was added and is ready to use.
en.ar_auto_key: Find and install the signing key automatically
en.ar_intro: Paste the repository line from the vendor's instructions or fill in the fields. EUS adds it, refreshes it on its own, and when the repository asks for a GPG key that is not installed, EUS searches the vendor's site and the keyservers for exactly that key, installs it into /etc/apt/keyrings/<name>.gpg and sets Signed-By, so the repository can be used right away.
en.ar_invalid_line: Enter a line such as: deb https://repo.example.org/debian stable main
en.auth: Administrator authentication was cancelled or failed.
en.available: Software updates are available for this computer
en.banner_major: Major system update: Debian {version} "{codename}" is the new stable base.
en.banner_os: Upgrade OS: {os} can move to Debian {version} "{codename}".
en.busy: Another EUS operation is still running. Wait for it to finish.
en.cg_flatpak: Flatpak applications do not publish a Debian changelog.
en.cg_none: No changelog is available for this update.
en.choose: Select an update to see its description.
en.cl_confirm: Clean the selected items and free about {size}?
en.cl_intro: Frees disk space safely: downloaded package files, packages that are no longer needed, leftover configuration of removed packages, old kernels (never the running one), old logs, crash reports and application caches. EUS also runs the package clean-up automatically after installing updates or removing kernels.
en.cl_nothing: Nothing to clean: the system is already clean.
en.clear_history_confirm: Permanently clear the EUS update history?
en.cm_select_same: Select only updates of this type
en.current: Your system is up to date
en.empty: No update information yet. Select Refresh.
en.fix_flatpak: Updates a sandboxed application or runtime.
en.fix_kernel: Updates the Linux kernel: hardware support, drivers and fixes.
en.fix_major: Moves Edukasaun OS to the new Debian stable release.
en.history_cleared: The update history has been cleared.
en.home_detail_security: {count} of them fix security problems. Install them soon.
en.home_major: A major system update is available
en.home_ok: Your system is up to date
en.hp_confirm: Apply {count} selected repair(s) and recommendation(s)? Administrator rights are needed.
en.hp_ok: No problem found. The system is healthy.
en.k_confirm_install:
Install {package}?

Restart the computer afterward to start using the new kernel.
en.k_headers: Also install matching kernel headers (needed by drivers such as NVIDIA or VirtualBox)
en.k_installed_ok: The kernel was installed. Restart the computer to start using it; the current kernel will then be marked as an old kernel.
en.k_meta: {package} — always the latest kernel of this series (recommended)
en.k_no_old: There is no old kernel to remove.
en.k_none_available: No other kernel is available from the configured repositories.
en.k_select: Select at least one removable kernel.
en.kernel_intro: The kernel in use can never be removed. After a new kernel is installed and the computer restarts, the previous kernel is marked “Old kernel” and can be removed safely.
en.kf_dup_partial: Partly duplicates {first} — repeated components will be removed
en.kf_intro: Key Fix first works out where each repository's key belongs: package keyrings in /usr/share/keyrings are never edited (their package is reinstalled), repository keyrings in /etc/apt/keyrings are used through Signed-By, and /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d is only for keys trusted by every repository. Missing or expired keys are then found on the internet and installed into exactly that place; duplicate repositories are disabled. Backups are kept in /var/backups/eus.
en.kf_keyring_global: {role}{package} · trusted for every repository without Signed-By
en.kf_last_update: Based on the last repository refresh: {time}
en.kf_legacy: Keys are stored in the deprecated trusted.gpg keyring
en.kf_no_refresh: Run Check for Updates once so EUS can detect missing keys.
en.kf_ok_keys: No GPG key problem was found.
en.kf_title: Key Fix — Repository and GPG Key Repair
en.kf_unreachable: Repository cannot be reached (network or address problem)
en.maintenance_intro: Keep the system lean: free disk space, manage kernels and review what EUS did.
en.major_confirm:
Install the major system update to Debian {version} "{codename}"?

{count} packages, {size} to download. This can take a long time; keep the computer connected to power and network. A restart is required at the end.
en.major_description: The new Debian stable release ({count} packages). Edukasaun OS follows stable continuously, so this is installed as one large system update: snapshot, minimal upgrade, full upgrade, clean-up. A restart is required afterwards.
en.mm_select_security: Select security and kernel updates only
en.no_history: No EUS history is available yet.
en.os_blocked: The upgrade cannot start yet: a distribution repository does not offer the new release.
en.os_checking: Checking every repository for the new release…
en.os_confirm:
Upgrade to Debian {target} now?

This can take a long time. Do not turn the computer off.
en.os_done: The operating system was upgraded. Restart the computer to finish.
en.os_intro: A new Debian stable release is available as the base of Edukasaun OS. EUS first brings the current release up to date, then switches every repository that offers the new release to its new codename. Third-party repositories that do not offer it yet stay on their current suite, so nothing conflicts. All repository files are backed up and restored automatically if the new repositories cannot be loaded.
en.os_none: No new Debian base release is available.
en.os_warning: Save your work and keep the computer connected to power and network. The upgrade can take a long time; a restart is required at the end.
en.partial_warning: APT may install required dependencies together with the selected packages.
en.recommend_kernel: Restart after installing; remove old kernels later in Kernel Manager.
en.recommend_major: Install when you have time; save your work first.
en.release_available: A new Edukasaun OS version is available
en.restart_body: The updates finished successfully, but important system changes are waiting for a restart. Save your work before continuing.
en.restart_may_be_required: This selection contains a kernel or core-system update. A restart may be required afterward.
en.restart_pending: Restart required to finish installing updates
en.risk_critical: Delaying leaves the computer exposed to known attacks.
en.risk_kernel: The current kernel stays installed and can still be chosen in the boot menu.
en.risk_major: Older releases stop receiving security updates about a year later.
en.risk_medium: Delaying can keep crashes or hardware problems.
en.sb_self_update: A new version of the Update Manager is available. Install it before the other updates.
en.settings_intro: Schedule, automatic updates, clean-up and notifications.
en.sources_intro: Repositories and their signing keys. Edukasaun OS follows Debian stable continuously.
en.st_auto_clean: Clean up after installing updates or removing kernels
en.st_auto_clean_tip: Removes packages that are no longer needed, leftover configuration of removed packages and downloaded package files.
en.st_auto_note: Automatic updates run after the scheduled check, only on AC power, and block shutdown while installing.
en.st_pause_note: While paused, EUS does not check automatically and shows no update notifications. You can still check and install manually.
en.st_timeshift: Create a Timeshift snapshot before installing updates
en.st_timeshift_missing: Create a Timeshift snapshot first (Timeshift is not installed)
en.subtitle: Software updates for Edukasaun OS
en.timeout: The update process stopped responding and was safely terminated. Check the network and try again.

tet.maximize_restore: Haboot ka fila ba tamañu normal
tet.mm_select_security: Select security and kernel updates only

tet.risk_critical: Risku aas: atrazu bele husik komputadór nakloke ba atake ka falla grave nebe koñesidu ona.
tet.risk_flatpak: Risku aplikasaun: atrazu bele husik bug, problema seguransa ka runtime la kompatível.
tet.risk_kernel: The current kernel stays installed and can still be chosen in the boot menu.

tet.risk_medium: Risku klaran: atrazu bele halo crash, problema hardware, kompatibilidade ka instabilidade kontinua.
tet.risk_normal: Risku ki'ik: bele atraza badak, maibe rekomenda instala atu sistema konfiavel.
